text: The library that mattered most was not at home but Willesden Public Library, five minutes' walk away. He calls it his Ur library: Ur is a German prefix meaning the original, the first of all libraries. There, he says, he received his real education. He disliked school; in class, information went in one ear and out the other. He could not learn passively. He was not a good pupil, but a good learner. In the library he roamed the shelves freely, followed what fascinated him, became himself, and enjoyed the quiet companionship of other readers on quests of their own.
